corpus.note: Signal rates, not accuracy. Package size alone separates the classes (size-only AUC about 0.79).

false_positive.note: Obscure small packages only; not a general false-positive rate.

evasion.note: 12 synthetic samples around one payload type. Shows evasion of the review flag, not of a suspicious verdict.

limits: Static analysis only; nothing is executed.
Package-wide combination rules can join unrelated files (5 of 6 flags in the FP check were false positives).
A setup.py over 2 MiB is skipped.
ROT13 is not treated as obfuscation.
